note: Baca County (08009) publishes no public queryable parcel polygon service. The state OIT Colorado_Public_Parcels layer has 0 features with countyFips 08009 and 0 with countyName like BACA (checked by where-clause queries). The county assessor site links no GIS or parcel service. Baca parcel data appears only via paid or commercial vendors (Equator, Dynamo Spatial, Regrid Pro, CountyGISMaps, Acres/AcreValue viewers), and no free ArcGIS REST parcel layer was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches (only commissioner district and precinct layers).
